newsitem.title: USA: Travelers to buy back $240.8 million in shares.
newsitem.headline: Travelers to buy back $240.8 million in shares.

text.p: Travelers Property Casualty Corp. said Monday it agreed to buy back about 6.6 million shares of its class A common stock from private investors for a total of about $240.8 million.
The company said the stock is held by Aetna Services Inc., J.P. Morgan Capital Corp., Fund American Enterprises Holdings and Trident Partnership LP.
It said the purchases represent 20 percent of the holdings of each of the private investors.
As part of the buyback agreement, the period that the investors are restricted from selling 50 percent of their remaining shares will be extended by six months to March 15, 1998.
Travelers Property said the deal satisfies its previously announced intention to buy back $100 million of its shares.

The company repurchased about 1.17 million shares in the programme, which is now ended. It said repurchased shares would be used for issuing of stock for various compensation plans and for other corporate purposes.
After the purchases, Travelers Group Inc.'s stake in Travelers Property Casualty will rise to 83.4 percent.
Travelers Property's stock was unchanged at $39.875 early on the New York Stock Exchange.
